project_type: Next.js App Router full-stack application - Carbon Intelligence Operating System (CIOS)
build_system: npm with Next.js, Prisma ORM for database schema
test_command: npx prisma validate && npm run lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx prisma validate to confirm schema is valid. 2. Run npm run build to confirm Next.js builds successfully. 3. Run npm run lint to confirm no lint errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated but not checked in (in .gitignore). node_modules not checked in.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to npm registries. Node.js v22 available. No database server running locally - Prisma validate only, no migrate.
contribution_requirements: Initial project setup - no prior contributions exist.
key_patterns: Next.js App Router with src/app directory structure. shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui. Prisma schema in prisma/schema.prisma. Modular architecture with 18 CIOS modules.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages and layouts. src/components/ - React components (ui/, layout/, modules/). src/lib/ - Utility functions, Prisma client, Supabase client. prisma/ - Prisma schema and migrations. public/ - Static assets.
